[Benzinga news, 2026-10-29T22:02:31Z, by staff] CareDx Reports Q3 2026 Financial Results and Raises Full-Year Guidance
CareDx, Inc. reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $139.4 million, exceeding analyst expectations, and increased its full-year 2026 revenue and adjusted EBITDA guidance.
CareDx, Inc. announced its financial results for the third quarter of 2026, reporting revenue of $139.4 million, which surpassed the FactSet consensus estimate of $122.0 million. The company also reported an adjusted EPS of $0.70 for the quarter. Driven by strong performance, including a 51% year-over-year increase in testing volume and an adjusted EBITDA margin of 22%, the company raised its full-year 2026 outlook. CareDx now expects full-year 2026 revenue to be in the range of $520 million to $530 million, with adjusted EBITDA projected between $90 million and $100 million.
